text: Eni S.p.A. is effectively Italian state-owned: the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) holds 2.166% directly and a further 30.918% indirectly through Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (which is 82.77% MEF-owned) - 33.084% in total, alongside a golden share - per Eni's own shareholder communications to its 2026 AGM.

source.name: Eni S.p.A. - Proposals of the Shareholder Ministry of the Economy and Finance (AGM 2026 filing)
